title: Second Brain for Mac and Windows
claim: Product Hunt: Second Brain for Mac and Windows — Your AI memory, everywhere you work
why_good: It runs locally on Mac and Windows, continuously capturing your screen, clipboard, and app activity, then uses AI to index and make it searchable. Unlike cloud-based tools, it keeps your data private and works offline.
value: Privacy-conscious professionals and developers pay for a subscription to get a searchable memory of their work without cloud exposure, saving time and reducing anxiety about forgetting important information.
risk: Microsoft Recall or Apple's similar feature could make this obsolete, and the creepy factor of constant screen recording might scare off mainstream users.
evidence: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Second Brain for Mac 和 Windows 是一个 AI 记忆层，捕获你在电脑上看到和做的一切，使其可搜索和可操作。
zh.hook: 知识工作者和开发者被分散的笔记、截图和浏览器标签页淹没，需要一种方式即时回忆他们在电脑上看到或做过的任何事情。
zh.does: 它在 Mac 和 Windows 上本地运行，持续捕获屏幕、剪贴板和应用程序活动，然后使用 AI 进行索引和搜索。与基于云的工具不同，它保持数据私有并支持离线工作。
zh.why_use: 无需手动记录，即可获得数字生活的照相记忆。它是私有的、本地的，敏感工作留在你的机器上，并且跨所有应用工作，而不仅仅是一个生态系统。
zh.gap: 当前解决方案要么是手动的（笔记应用），要么是基于云的（如 Rewind.ai），存在隐私问题；没有一款精致的、本地优先的、跨平台的 AI 记忆工具面向普通用户。
zh.counter: Rewind.ai 已经拥有 Mac 的“AI 记忆”叙事，微软的 Recall 即将登陆 Windows，可能以内置功能杀死它。此外，持续屏幕捕获的隐私问题可能限制采用。
zh.differentiator: 将其包装为本地优先、跨平台的工具，具有强加密和设备端 AI，面向注重隐私的专业人士和开发者，他们不信任云解决方案。
zh.value: 注重隐私的专业人士和开发者订阅付费，以获得无需云暴露的可搜索工作记忆，节省时间并减少遗忘重要信息的焦虑。
zh.risk: 微软 Recall 或苹果的类似功能可能使其过时，持续屏幕录制的怪异感可能吓跑主流用户。
zh.why_good: 它在 Mac 和 Windows 上本地运行，持续捕获屏幕、剪贴板和应用程序活动，然后使用 AI 进行索引和搜索。与基于云的工具不同，它保持数据私有并支持离线工作。

does: It runs locally on Mac and Windows, continuously capturing your screen, clipboard, and app activity, then uses AI to index and make it searchable. Unlike cloud-based tools, it keeps your data private and works offline.
why_use: You get a photographic memory for your digital life without manual logging. It's private and local, so sensitive work stays on your machine, and it works across all apps, not just one ecosystem.
gap: Local AI memory capture is still niche; no verified demand beyond upvotes.
counter: Rewind.ai already owns the 'AI memory' narrative for Mac, and Microsoft's Recall is coming to Windows, which could kill this with a built-in feature. Also, privacy concerns around continuous screen capture may limit adoption.
differentiator: Package it as a local-first, cross-platform tool with strong encryption and on-device AI, targeting privacy-conscious professionals and developers who distrust cloud solutions.
hook: Knowledge workers and developers drowning in scattered notes, screenshots, and browser tabs need a way to instantly recall anything they've seen or done on their computer.
consumer_angle: Ordinary users want private, searchable memory of their work, but this is still a developer-oriented tool.
pick_reason: No first-hand pain evidence; upvotes are attention, not demand.
